trust.title: Trust Center
trust.intro: What protects your data, stated so you can check it. Every control below points at a certificate, a public fact, or a control register in our repository — and the ones we have not built yet are listed as such rather than left out.
trust.verifiedOn: Controls verified against the implementation on

controls.heading: Security controls
controls.note: “Planned” means specified and scheduled, but not running in production today.

keys.label: Key protection
keys.detail: Data-encryption keys are generated and used inside AWS Key Management Service hardware security modules. The module is validated by NIST; the certificate is linked below and is active until 17 November 2026, when it must be re-verified.

atRest.label: Encryption at rest
atRest.detail: All databases, object storage and backups, using a customer-managed key.

fieldLevel.label: Field-level encryption
fieldLevel.detail: Individual sensitive fields, such as MFA secrets and signing keys, are separately encrypted before storage.

inTransit.label: Encryption in transit
inTransit.detail: TLS 1.3 is the minimum on every public endpoint; earlier TLS versions are disabled.

isolation.label: Tenant isolation
isolation.detail: Every table carries a database-enforced policy so one organisation cannot read another's rows, even if the application layer is bypassed. A cross-tenant test runs on every build.

mesh.label: Service-to-service mTLS
mesh.detail: Mutual TLS between internal services is specified but is not yet deployed.

logRedaction.label: Automatic log redaction
logRedaction.detail: Personal data is kept out of logs by engineering convention; automated redaction is not yet enforced.

subjectRights.label: Self-service data requests
subjectRights.detail: Access, portability, erasure and restriction requests are handled by our Data Protection Office; a self-service endpoint is not yet built.

breach.label: Automated breach notification
breach.detail: The 72-hour notification workflow required by PDPA is not yet implemented.

certs.heading: Certifications
certs.note: We hold none of these today. They are listed with their target so the status is not ambiguous.

soc2.label: SOC 2 Type II
soc2.detail: Security, Availability, Confidentiality. Audit begins 6 months before our Stage 1→2 transition.

iso27001.label: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
iso27001.detail: Information Security Management System. No ISMS is established yet — the largest gap to certification.

pdpa.label: PDPA audit (Thailand)
pdpa.detail: Annual audit, triggered 6 months before the first Thai enterprise customer onboards.

subprocessors.heading: Sub-processors
subprocessors.note: Third parties that may process personal data on our behalf.

awsSns.name: AWS SNS
awsSns.purpose: Sign-in code (SMS) delivery — pinned to the SMS-capable endpoint

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.purpose: AI report generation. Personal data is removed before any text is sent

residency.heading: Data residency
residency.body: Data is stored in the home region assigned to your organisation: Thailand (ap-southeast-7) for Thai organisations, Ireland (eu-west-1) for EU organisations, and Singapore (ap-southeast-1) otherwise, with Singapore as the disaster-recovery region for Thai data. The one routine cross-border transfer is SMS sign-in code delivery.

trust.footer: Questions about this page, or a request to exercise your data rights, go to our Data Protection Office — the address is published in the Privacy Policy in the app.
